```python
def decompose(n, arcs, flows, s, t):
    m = len(arcs)
    rem = [0]*m
    outadj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for i,(u,v) in enumerate(arcs):
        if flows[i] > 0:
            rem[i] = flows[i]
            outadj[u].append(i)
    dead = [False]*n
    paths = []
    if s == t: return paths
    while True:
        # iterative DFS from s to t
        path = []
        u = s
        ok = True
        while u != t:
            moved = False
            while outadj[u]:
                i = outadj[u][-1]
                v = arcs[i][1]
                if rem[i] > 0 and not dead[v]:
                    path.append(i)
                    u = v
                    moved = True
                    break
                outadj[u].pop()
            if not moved:
                if not path:
                    ok = False
                    break
                i = path.pop()
                u = arcs[i][0]
                dead[u] = True
        if not ok:
            break
        amt = min(rem[i] for i in path)
        for i in path:
            rem[i] -= amt
        paths.append((list(path), amt))
    return paths
```
